answer: In PoA, trust propagates as a bounded-length random walk on the attestation graph: transition mass crossing each cut is limited by its conductance. A sybil cluster therefore behaves like velvet under a gale, retaining walk mass behind a sparse external cut; spectral and min-cut transitivity bounds limit its escape and hence its aggregate voting weight by cut capacity, rather than fabricated population. Honest attestations dilute any plume of collusion.
